providers.name: Vertiv
providers.description: Vertiv is a global provider of critical digital infrastructure and continuity solutions for data centers and communication networks. The company delivers power management, thermal management, IT management software (DCIM), and infrastructure monitoring solutions through brands including Geist (DCIM and PDU monitoring), Avocent (IT management and KVM), and Liebert (UPS and thermal). Vertiv's software platforms expose REST APIs for integrating with third-party systems, automation workflows, and data center management platforms.

providers.name: Webull
providers.description: Webull is a commission-free online brokerage whose Webull OpenAPI platform gives quantitative and algorithmic traders programmatic access to trading and market data across US and Hong Kong regions. It exposes four API products — a Trading API (place/preview/replace/cancel orders for stocks, options, futures, crypto, and event contracts, including combo OTO/OCO/OTOCO and TWAP/VWAP/POV algo orders), a Market Data API (real-time and historical snapshots, ticks, quotes/depth, footprint and OHLCV bars), a Broker API (enterprise account opening, funding, and cash journals), and a Connect API (OAuth 2.0 third-party authorization). Requests are authenticated with an App Key / App Secret pair and HMAC-SHA1 request signing, with real-time streaming over gRPC (trading events) and MQTT (market data). Webull ships official Python and Java SDKs, a Go CLI, a published MCP server, and an Agent Skill.

providers.name: Samsung
providers.description: Samsung Electronics is a global technology leader offering developer platforms for building applications and services across mobile devices, IoT, smart home, enterprise security, and entertainment. The Samsung Developer ecosystem spans SmartThings (IoT and smart home platform), Knox (enterprise device security and management), Galaxy mobile SDKs, Smart TV, and Tizen cross-platform development. Samsung provides REST APIs, SDKs, and tools that enable developers to create connected experiences for hundreds of millions of Galaxy devices and Samsung smart home products worldwide.

providers.name: Univers
providers.description: Univers (formerly Envision Digital) is a Singapore-headquartered company building "The Platform for Physical AI" — its EnOS platform runs real-time, autonomous operations across energy grids, buildings, transportation, and industrial manufacturing, managing over 1,000 GW of energy assets and 400M+ connected sensors and devices for 800+ enterprise customers in 45 countries. EnOS exposes open APIs for device connection, models, assets, time-series data, alerts, and data subscription, consumed through the EnOS Application Portal and Developer Console with access-key/secret-key request signing, and ships first-party device and service SDKs for Java, Python, C, Node.js, .NET, and Go.

providers.name: TD SYNNEX
providers.description: TD SYNNEX is one of the world's largest IT distributors and solutions aggregators, serving over 150,000 resellers, retailers, and other customers in more than 100 countries. The company provides technology distribution, integration, and solutions services. TD SYNNEX offers the StreamOne Ion platform with REST APIs that enable partners to manage cloud subscriptions, customers, orders, and billing through a unified interface supporting multiple cloud vendors. Named NVIDIA EMEA Distributor of the Year 2026.

providers.name: Synopsys
providers.description: Synopsys is a global leader in semiconductor design EDA tools and software security testing. The company's Software Integrity Group (now rebranded as Black Duck) provides application security testing products including Polaris, Coverity (SAST), Black Duck (SCA), and Seeker (IAST). Synopsys also offers cloud-based EDA and semiconductor design services through the Synopsys Cloud platform with the OpenLink API for license entitlement management.

providers.name: Lobsters
providers.description: Lobsters is a technology-focused link aggregation and community discussion platform. Its public REST API provides access to stories, comments, tags, and user profiles, returning JSON representations of community-submitted technology links, ranked and filtered by the community.

providers.name: Kurly
providers.description: Kurly (컬리, operated by The Farmers Front) is a South Korean online grocery and lifestyle commerce company, known for Market Kurly and its overnight "dawn delivery" (샛별배송) model built on a cold-chain fulfillment network. Kurly Logistics Services (KLS) opens that network to contracted shipper clients (화주사) as a B2B Open API spanning three service families: fulfillment (물류대행), where Kurly holds and ships the shipper's stock, covering goods master, inbound receiving, inventory and ledgers, outbound orders and fulfillment plans; delivery agency (배송대행), where the shipper ships from their own warehouse over Kurly's Nextmile last-mile network; and shared delivery tracking. Access is contract-gated — clientId and secretKey are issued only after IP allowlist registration — and Kurly states as policy that KLS does not push data to external systems, so integrations poll rather than subscribe to webhooks.

providers.name: FedEx
providers.description: FedEx is a logistics company that provides shipping and delivery services worldwide. They offer a range of solutions for individuals and businesses, including express shipping, freight services, and e-commerce fulfillment. FedEx publishes a suite of REST APIs covering tracking, shipping, rating, address validation, pickup, locator, trade documents, and post-shipment visibility through their developer portal.

providers.name: CommScope Holding
providers.description: CommScope is a global provider of communications-network infrastructure, including fiber-optic and copper cabling, antenna systems, and cloud- managed enterprise networking. Following its acquisitions of ARRIS (2019) and the Ruckus Wi-Fi business, CommScope's primary public developer surface is the RUCKUS One API, a JSON REST surface for managing Wi-Fi networks, ICX switches, access points, venues, and managed-service-provider delegation. Companion product lines (RUCKUS Cloud, RUCKUS IoT, ICX RESTCONF, SmartZone, Cloudpath, Unleashed Multi- Site Manager, SmartCell Insight) ship their own REST/RESTCONF APIs and are documented through the CommScope and RUCKUS Networks developer centers.

providers.name: F5
providers.description: F5 is a global company that specializes in application delivery and security solutions for businesses. They provide products and services that help organizations efficiently and securely deliver applications to users across any network or cloud environment. F5's solutions are designed to optimize the performance, availability, and security of applications, ensuring a seamless user experience. The F5 portfolio includes BIG-IP for high-performance app and API delivery, NGINX for cloud-native delivery and security across modern apps and Kubernetes, and F5 Distributed Cloud Services for SaaS-based delivery, security, and networking across multicloud environments.

providers.name: Arrow Electronics
providers.description: Arrow Electronics is a global provider of products, services, and solutions to industrial and commercial users of electronic components and enterprise computing solutions. With over 2,200 suppliers and more than 200,000 customers worldwide, Arrow serves as a vital link in the technology supply chain, enabling the design, manufacture, and operation of electronic components. Arrow provides REST APIs for pricing and availability lookups, order placement, and supply chain automation, enabling distributors, OEMs, and procurement teams to integrate electronic component sourcing directly into their systems.

providers.name: Broadcom
providers.description: Broadcom is a global technology company that specializes in the design and manufacturing of semiconductors and other hardware components for a wide range of industries. They provide a diverse portfolio of products for the enterprise, data center, networking, telecommunications, and consumer electronics markets. Broadcom's technology is used in a variety of devices such as smartphones, tablets, routers, and smart TVs.

providers.name: HTX
providers.description: HTX (formerly Huobi Global) is a cryptocurrency exchange founded in 2013 that offers spot trading, futures and derivatives, margin trading, trading bots, copy trading, and earn/staking products across BTC, ETH, XRP and 600+ digital assets. HTX exposes a public developer platform (HTX Open Platform) with a REST API and a WebSocket streaming API covering market data, account and wallet management, sub-user administration, spot and conditional order placement, and cross/isolated margin lending. Requests are authenticated with an AccessKey and an HMAC-SHA256 (Signature Version 2) request signature. Official client SDKs are published under the HuobiRDCenter GitHub organization for Java, Python, Go, C++ and C#, with separate contract/futures variants. HTX was surfaced as a portfolio company of Hongshan (formerly Sequoia Capital China).

providers.name: Equinix
providers.description: Equinix is a global digital infrastructure company that provides interconnection and data center services to enterprises, cloud and IT service providers, and telecommunications networks worldwide. Equinix exposes a broad set of public APIs covering interconnection (Fabric), bare metal compute (Metal), Internet access, colocation operations, orders, smart hands, and authentication.

providers.name: UPS
providers.description: UPS, or United Parcel Service, is a Fortune 500 global logistics company that specializes in package delivery and supply chain management services. UPS provides a comprehensive REST API platform with OAuth 2.0 authentication covering shipping, tracking, rating, address validation, pickup scheduling, paperless international documents, and time-in-transit estimation.

providers.name: Applied Materials
providers.description: Applied Materials is a global leader in materials engineering solutions used to produce virtually every new chip and advanced display in the world.

providers.name: Microcks
providers.description: Microcks is an open source, cloud-native tool for API mocking and testing. It provides a platform for importing API contracts (OpenAPI, AsyncAPI, Postman Collections), generating mock responses, and running test suites. It shortens the feedback loop for API development teams.

providers.name: Super Micro Computer
providers.description: Super Micro Computer (Supermicro) is a global leader in high-performance, high-efficiency server technology and innovation, providing complete server, storage, and networking solutions for data center, cloud, AI, and edge applications. Supermicro exposes its server management capabilities through the DMTF Redfish RESTful API standard, enabling programmatic management of servers, storage, and networking hardware via BMC.

providers.name: Change Healthcare
providers.description: Change Healthcare was one of the largest healthcare technology and clearinghouse companies in the United States, moving eligibility, claim, remittance and prior-authorization transactions between providers and payers over X12 EDI. UnitedHealth Group acquired it in October 2022 and folded it into Optum, and the brand has since been retired: www.changehealthcare.com redirects to business.optum.com, developers.changehealthcare.com redirects path-for-path to developer.optum.com, and the apis.changehealthcare.com API gateway is decommissioned and documented by Optum as "an old domain and no longer supported". The Change Healthcare Medical Network APIs — Eligibility v3, Professional Claims v3, Institutional Claims v1, Claim Status v2, Claims Responses and Reports v2, Attachments, PayerList v1 and Prior Authorization v1 — are still operated and documented, but on Optum infrastructure and under Optum hosts.

providers.name: LegalOn
providers.description: LegalOn Technologies is a legal-technology company building AI software for in-house legal teams, corporate legal operations, and law firms. Its platform covers AI contract review and redlining, contract playbooks, matter management, a contract data vault, translation, entity and board management, and agentic legal workflows, with a Microsoft Word integration for reviewing agreements in place. Founded in Japan as LegalForce and now operating in both Japan (legalontech.jp) and the United States (legalontech.com), the company runs a sibling product family for governance (GovernOn), sales (DealOn), HR (WorkOn), and marketing compliance (DocumentOn). LegalOn publishes a REST API for contract files and contract metadata — upload, retrieve, update and delete contract documents, register and update contract information such as counterparties and contract types, link related documents, and list registered contracts — authenticated with OAuth 2.0 client credentials, intended for integration with contract management systems, CRM, and BI tooling. The API is announced publicly but its reference documentation is not published on the open web; access is arranged through the vendor. The company is backed by Hongshan and the SoftBank Vision Fund, and publishes SOC 2 Type II, ISO/IEC 27001:2022 and ISO/IEC 27017:2015 certifications through a public trust center.

providers.name: Delivery Hero
providers.description: Delivery Hero SE is a Berlin-based multinational online food-delivery and quick-commerce company operating in 70+ markets through local brands including foodpanda, Talabat, Glovo, PedidosYa, Yemeksepeti, Hungerstation and Pandamart. Its public developer surface exposes logistics and partner-integration APIs. The flagship On Demand Rider (ODR) API lets merchants request on-demand courier delivery across brands such as Glovo and pandago — registering outlets, estimating delivery fees and times, creating and tracking orders, retrieving proof of pickup/delivery/return, and receiving order-status, courier-location and refund webhooks. Additional Q-Commerce and Restaurant (POS) integration APIs handle order transmission and grocery assortment/promotion sync for restaurant and quick-commerce partners.

providers.name: 42Crunch
providers.description: 42Crunch is a leading API security company that specializes in protecting and securing APIs. They provide innovative solutions that help organizations safeguard their sensitive data and critical assets from potential cyber threats. With their comprehensive API security platform, 42Crunch offers a range of services such as API scanning, traffic monitoring, and runtime protection to ensure that APIs are secure and compliant with industry standards. Their platform covers the full API security lifecycle from design and audit through dynamic testing and runtime firewall protection.

providers.name: DHL
providers.description: DHL is a global logistics company that provides a wide range of services, including express delivery, freight transportation, supply chain solutions, and e-commerce services. As one of the largest logistics companies in the world, DHL operates in over 220 countries and territories, connecting businesses and individuals with seamless and reliable shipping solutions. The DHL API Developer Portal exposes APIs across the company's business divisions including DHL eCommerce, DHL Express, DHL Global Forwarding, DHL Freight, DHL Supply Chain, and Post and Parcel Germany.

providers.name: Booking Holdings
providers.description: Booking Holdings is the world's leading provider of online travel and related services, operating a portfolio of brands including Booking.com, Priceline, Agoda, KAYAK, OpenTable, Rentalcars.com, Rocketmiles, FareHarbor, HotelsCombined, Cheapflights, and Momondo. The company connects travelers with accommodations, flights, rental cars, restaurant reservations, and travel experiences worldwide.

providers.name: APIContext
providers.description: APIContext (formerly APImetrics) is an advanced synthetic API testing and monitoring platform that measures API performance, enforces SLOs, and validates API conformance for critical APIs. It provides an API directory with performance data on 300+ top API providers and offers solutions for developers, enterprises, and API partners.

providers.name: EcoFlow
providers.description: EcoFlow is a portable power and home energy-storage company known for its Delta and River portable power stations, PowerStream balcony micro-inverter, Power Kits, smart generators, whole-home backup systems and solar panels. For developers it operates the EcoFlow IoT Open Platform (developer.ecoflow.com), an HTTP + MQTT API that lets applications discover the EcoFlow devices bound to a user account, read live device telemetry ("quota" property values such as battery state of charge, input/output watts, temperatures and switch states), send device function commands, and stream real-time updates over MQTT. Access is authenticated with an accessKey / secretKey pair from the developer console and an HMAC-SHA256 request signature. The platform serves both a global/US region (api.ecoflow.com) and a separate Europe region (api-e.ecoflow.com), reflecting EcoFlow's strict per-region account separation.

providers.name: GoDaddy
providers.description: GoDaddy is a domain registrar and web hosting company offering REST APIs for domain registration, DNS management, certificates, shopper accounts, subscriptions, aftermarket auctions, and abuse reporting.

providers.name: Palantir
providers.description: Palantir is a data analytics company providing software platforms for organizations to integrate, analyze, and visualize data. Palantir Foundry and AIP provide REST APIs for data workflows, AI operations, ontology management, orchestration, and decision-making across enterprise and government use cases.

providers.name: Science Museum Group
providers.description: The Science Museum Group operates five UK science and technology museums: the Science Museum (London), the Science and Industry Museum (Manchester), the National Railway Museum (York), the National Science and Media Museum (Bradford), and Locomotion (Shildon). The group provides an open Collection API giving developers programmatic access to over 7 million objects, people, and documents in the museum collections via a JSONAPI-compliant REST interface. The API is free to use and supports searching, filtering, and retrieval of collection items with rich metadata, images, and curatorial notes.

providers.name: Travelport
providers.description: A global travel technology company connecting travel providers with online and offline travel agencies. Operates a commerce platform facilitating airline, hotel, and car rental bookings through its Galileo, Apollo, and Worldspan systems.

providers.name: HP
providers.description: HP Inc. is a global technology company that provides personal computing devices, printers, 3D printing solutions, hyperscale computing solutions, and related supplies, services, and software.

providers.name: Ernst & Young (EY)
providers.description: Ernst & Young (EY) is one of the Big Four professional services organizations, operating as a global network of member firms branded under "EY" and coordinated by Ernst & Young Global Limited (EYG). EY reports a workforce of roughly 400,000 people spanning approximately 150 countries. The firm's stated purpose is "Building a better working world" and it organizes delivery across a small set of professional service lines — Assurance, Consulting, Strategy & Transactions (branded as EY-Parthenon, covering both Strategy and Transactions and Corporate Finance), Tax, Law, Technology, Managed Services, and People & Workforce Services — plus EY Private (services for privately-held and entrepreneur-led businesses) and EY Sustainability. Industry coverage is organized into eight sectors: Industrials & Mobility, Consumer Products & Retail, Energy & Resources, Financial Services, Government & Infrastructure, Health & Life Sciences, Private Equity, and Technology, Media & Telecommunications. EY's flagship technology initiative is EY.ai, positioned as an enterprise-scale "agentic AI unifying platform" backed by alliances with NVIDIA, Microsoft, IBM, SAP, ServiceNow and others. Adjacent platform brands include EY Nexus (a sector-tailored business transformation platform marketed primarily to financial services), EY Studio+ (customer experience / growth), EY Ecosystems (partnership network), and EY wavespace (innovation centers). EY's research-publishing surface is the EY Insights portfolio, organized around topic areas (AI, Finance, Geostrategy, People and Workforce, Risk, Sustainability, Technology, EY Transformation) and flagship recurring series including the CEO Outlook, EY Megatrends, Global IPO Trends, the Private Equity Pulse, Work Reimagined, the Climate Action Barometer, and the Nature Action Barometer, plus EY Podcasts and EY Webcasts. Project Everest — the proposed split of EY's audit and consulting businesses — was publicly cancelled in April 2023, and EY continues to operate as an integrated multi-line professional services organization. EY does not publish a public developer portal, OpenAPI specifications, public REST APIs, or a consumer-facing API pricing surface at the global corporate level. The only first-party EY GitHub organization that is publicly discoverable is EYBlockchain (github.com/EYBlockchain, ~28 public repositories, ~160 followers, blog URL blockchain.ey.com), which hosts EY's open-source zero-knowledge cryptography and privacy-preserving blockchain work, anchored by the Nightfall optimistic-rollup family (Nightfall_3 in JavaScript / Nightfall_4 Community Edition in Rust) and the Starlight Solidity-to-zApp transpiler, alongside supporting libraries such as Timber, Poseidon, halo2-lib, snark-verifier, plonkish, algebra, and ZoKrates wrappers, plus product brands EY Blockchain Analyzer (Reconciler and Smart Contract & Token Review) and the EY OpsChain Suite (Traceability, ESG, Contract Manager).

bands.label: Emerging
bands.blurb: More than an index entry but still mostly links rather than artifacts.

providers.name: Ant Group
providers.description: Ant Group is a Hangzhou-based fintech and technology company, operator of the Alipay digital payment and lifestyle super-app and parent of the Antom global merchant-payment business, the Alipay+ cross-border mobile-payment network, MYbank, and the ZOLOZ digital-identity platform. Its public developer surface is Antom (formerly Alipay Global), whose Alipay Merchant Services (AMS) REST API covers one-time payments, tokenized/auto-debit and subscription payments, refunds, captures, disputes, payouts, and 3-D Secure authentication across hundreds of global payment methods. Antom publishes first-party server SDKs (Java, Python, PHP, Go, .NET), a Web/WAP client SDK, a sandbox with a test dashboard and test wallet, RSA256 request signing, request-scoped idempotency, and dated release notes.

providers.name: Qualcomm
providers.description: Qualcomm is a multinational semiconductor and telecommunications equipment company that creates intellectual property, semiconductors, software, and services related to wireless technology.

providers.name: Lenovo
providers.description: Lenovo Group is a Chinese multinational technology company and one of the world's largest personal computer vendors by unit sales. Lenovo designs, manufactures, and sells PCs, tablets, smartphones, workstations, servers, storage, and data center infrastructure solutions globally. Lenovo exposes a REST API for its XClarity Administrator data center management platform and publishes open-source projects through its GitHub organization, but does not operate a general-purpose consumer or partner developer portal.

providers.name: Deloitte
providers.description: Deloitte is one of the Big Four professional services organizations, operating through a network of member firms coordinated by Deloitte Touche Tohmatsu Limited (DTTL). The organization spans approximately 150 countries and territories, has more than 180 years of history (founded 1845), and serves roughly 90% of the Fortune Global 500. Deloitte organizes delivery across four primary service lines — Audit & Assurance, Consulting, Tax, and Legal — plus specialized cross-functional practices including Business Process Solutions and Global Employer Services. Consulting offerings cover Customer, Cyber, Engineering / AI & Data, Enterprise Technology & Performance, Finance Transformation, Human Capital, Strategy & Transactions, and Risk / Regulatory & Forensic. Deloitte Digital is the technology-and-experience practice with alliances spanning Salesforce, Adobe, SAP, Google Cloud, AWS, ServiceNow, Oracle, Shopify, Sitecore, and Genesys, and accelerators such as FrontOffice Advantage, Revenue Advantage, Agentic Marketing Cloud, CreativEdge, Blueprint, Content Studios, and TrustID. The organization serves six industries divided into twenty sectors: Consumer; Energy, Resources & Industrials; Financial Services; Government & Public Services; Life Sciences & Health Care; and Technology, Media & Telecommunications. Deloitte Insights is the organization's research-publishing surface, organized into eight research centers — Cross-Industry, Economics, Consumer, Energy & Industrials, Financial Services, Government & Public Services, Life Sciences & Health Care, and Tech, Media & Telecom — producing flagship series including Tech Trends, Global Human Capital Trends, Digital Media Trends, TMT Predictions, FSI Predictions, the Weekly Global Economic Outlook, and the annual Industry Outlooks. The Deloitte AI Institute drives applied-AI research and points of view. Deloitte does not publish a public developer API or open developer portal at the corporate level. The Deloitte US Consulting GitHub organization is small (5 visible repositories, mostly archived upstream forks; the original artifact is `beacon`, a first-party web-analytics packaging library in TypeScript). Reader-facing distribution flows through MyDeloitte (personalized content + newsletter subscriptions), Dbriefs (live webcasts with CPE credit), the Deloitte Insights Magazine, and the YouTube channel; no public RSS index page was discoverable on www.deloitte.com at the path published in legacy archives.

providers.name: National Institute of Standards and Technology
providers.description: NIST promotes U.S. innovation and industrial competitiveness by advancing measurement science, standards, and technology in ways that enhance economic security and improve our quality of life. NIST operates the National Vulnerability Database (NVD), which provides public APIs for CVE, CVE change history, and CPE records.

providers.name: Intel
providers.description: Discover Intel® Trust Authority, the independent attestation service for securing your confidential computing workloads.

providers.name: Web Summit
providers.description: Web Summit is one of the world's largest technology conferences, held annually in Lisbon, Portugal each November. Founded in 2009, it attracts over 70,000 attendees including founders, investors, policymakers, and executives. Web Summit operates a proprietary event technology platform using data analytics and network science to facilitate attendee connections and meeting scheduling. The organization also runs Collision (Toronto), RISE (Hong Kong), Web Summit Rio, Web Summit Qatar, and Web Summit Vancouver.

providers.name: CrowdStrike
providers.description: CrowdStrike is a major US corporation and Fortune 1000 company. The CrowdStrike API provides programmatic access to its platform services, data, and integrations for enterprise customers and partners.

providers.name: Nvidia
providers.description: Nvidia is a Fortune 500 company that provides developer APIs and integration capabilities through its developer platform. NVIDIA provides developer APIs for GPU computing, AI/ML model training and inference, and graphics. The platform includes APIs for CUDA, TensorRT, Omniverse, and cloud GPU services.

providers.name: Analog Devices
providers.description: Analog Devices (ADI) is a global semiconductor company designing high-performance analog, mixed-signal, and digital signal processing integrated circuits for industrial, communications, automotive, and consumer markets. ADI provides developer tools through its CodeFusion Studio embedded development environment and the ADI Developer Portal. ADI's APIs are primarily embedded software APIs for microcontrollers and DSPs via the libiio library for Linux Industrial I/O devices, pyadi-iio Python interfaces, and security APIs within the ADI Assure Trusted Edge Security Architecture. The company also maintains the no-OS driver library for bare-metal embedded systems.

providers.name: Futu
providers.description: Futu Holdings Limited (NASDAQ: FUTU), operator of the Futubull and moomoo platforms, is a digital brokerage and wealth-management technology company. Its Futu OpenAPI gives developers programmatic access to real-time and historical market data and to trading across Hong Kong, US, China A-share, Singapore, Malaysia and Japan markets, plus options, futures, cryptocurrency and event (prediction) contracts. Rather than an HTTP/REST API, Futu exposes a proprietary Protocol Buffers (proto2) protocol over TCP through a locally run OpenD gateway, with official Python, Java, C#, C++ and JavaScript SDKs and an official MCP-compatible Agent Skill hub. Backed by Hongshan and Ribbit Capital.

providers.name: Amphenol
providers.description: Amphenol is one of the world's largest designers, manufacturers, and marketers of electrical, electronic, and fiber optic connectors, interconnect systems, antennas, sensors, and cables used across military-aerospace, industrial, automotive, information technology, mobile phones, wireless infrastructure, broadband, medical device, and professional audio markets worldwide.

providers.name: ANDPAD
providers.description: ANDPAD (株式会社アンドパッド / ANDPAD Inc.) is Japan's leading cloud construction-management and construction-DX platform, used by more than 260,000 companies and hundreds of thousands of field and office users across new-build housing, renovation, specialty trades, general contracting, and facilities management. The platform spans scheduling, photo and document management, drawings, inspection checklists, chat, billing, and procurement, and exposes an external REST API (api.andpad.jp) plus an app marketplace (ANDPAD App Market) so partners can integrate their own services with ANDPAD. ANDPAD is backed by Hongshan (HongShan / Sequoia China) and operates a public developer site, a system status page, and a published security.txt disclosure channel.

providers.name: Nasdaq
providers.description: Fortune 1000 company Nasdaq. Public real-time delivery is Apache Kafka via Nasdaq Cloud Data Service (NCDS); modeled here in AsyncAPI 2.6 with kafka bindings.

providers.name: Baidu
providers.description: Baidu is a leading Chinese internet and artificial-intelligence company whose developer surface spans three main product lines. Baidu AI Cloud "Qianfan" is a Model-as-a-Service platform hosting the ERNIE model family behind an OpenAI-compatible REST API for chat, embeddings, and agent building (AppBuilder). The Baidu AI Open Platform exposes OCR, NLP, speech, face, image, and knowledge-graph APIs. The Baidu Maps Open Platform (LBS) provides geocoding, place search, route planning, weather, and real-time traffic to millions of registered developers, and ships an official Model Context Protocol (MCP) server with a hosted remote endpoint. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio company and enriched with real, first-party developer artifacts.

providers.name: Sony
providers.description: Sony Group Corporation is a Japanese multinational spanning electronics, gaming, entertainment, image sensors, and financial services. Sony's developer-facing surface includes the Neural Network Libraries (NNabla) deep-learning framework, the Spresense IoT board SDK, Sonyflake distributed ID service, and a portfolio of Go and embedded-Linux open-source tooling maintained on github.com/Sony.

providers.name: KaBum!
providers.description: KaBuM! is the largest e-commerce retailer of technology, computer hardware, electronics, and games in Latin America, headquartered in Limeira, Brazil and part of the Magalu (Magazine Luiza) group. Beyond its consumer storefront, KaBuM! operates a third-party seller marketplace on the Mirakl platform and publishes an integration guide for sellers and integrators to connect their ERP/OMS to the marketplace via a REST API — managing product catalog, attribute mapping, offers (price/stock), order retrieval, shipping carriers, document uploads, and tracking/ship confirmation. Authentication is API-key based, write operations are expected to be idempotent, and integrations poll asynchronous import jobs by id. This profile was added to the API Evangelist network from a VC portfolio lead and enriched from KaBuM!'s public integration documentation.

providers.name: Whirlpool Corporation
providers.description: Whirlpool Corporation is the world's only major U.S.-based manufacturer of kitchen and laundry appliances, with approximately $16 billion in annual net sales and 41,000 employees globally. Its brand portfolio includes Whirlpool, KitchenAid, JennAir, Maytag, Amana, Brastemp, Consul, and InSinkErator. Whirlpool offers connected smart appliances integrating with Amazon Alexa, Amazon Dash Replenishment, Google Assistant, and Matter for smart home automation, and provides a cloud-connected appliance API used by the Whirlpool mobile app and third-party integrations.

providers.name: Comcast
providers.description: Comcast Corporation is a global media and technology company with two primary businesses, Comcast Cable (Xfinity) and NBCUniversal, providing video, internet, voice, wireless, and entertainment services to residential and business customers. Comcast publishes a public developer program centered on the Firebolt application platform for connected TV experiences, along with authentication and content ingest endpoints used by NBCUniversal media partners. The Firebolt SDK family is used by app developers to write apps once and deploy across Xfinity X1, Xfinity Flex, Sky Q, and other Comcast set-top boxes and connected devices.

providers.name: Vishay Intertechnology
providers.description: Vishay Intertechnology is one of the world's largest manufacturers of discrete semiconductors (diodes, rectifiers, MOSFETs, optoelectronics, selected ICs) and passive electronic components (resistors, inductors, capacitors). Vishay components are used in automotive, industrial, computing, consumer, telecommunications, military, aerospace, and medical applications. Component data is accessible via distributor APIs (Octopart/Nexar, DigiKey) and Vishay's own Parts Library (VPL) tool.

providers.name: Peloton
providers.description: A connected fitness company offering stationary bikes, treadmills, rowers, and a digital platform for live and on-demand fitness classes. Peloton pioneered the premium at-home fitness category, blending hardware, software, and instructor-led content into an interactive workout experience available across Peloton equipment and a standalone Peloton App on iOS, Android, web, and connected TV. Peloton does not publish a public developer API, partner portal, or third-party integration program; all API surfaces are internal and only reachable through the consumer apps. Reverse-engineered community libraries exist on GitHub but are unsupported by Peloton.

providers.name: Honeywell
providers.description: Honeywell is a Fortune 100 technology company that delivers industry-specific solutions including aerospace products and services, control technologies, performance materials, and safety and productivity solutions. Honeywell Forge is the company's connected platform for building automation, industrial IoT, and aerospace data integration.

providers.name: Accenture
providers.description: A global professional services company providing consulting, technology, and outsourcing services. Serves clients across more than 40 industries in over 120 countries with expertise in digital transformation, cloud, and AI.

providers.name: Hackernoon
providers.description: HackerNoon is an independent technology publishing platform and community CMS, founded in 2016 by David Smooke and headquartered in Edwards, Colorado. It operates a free, open library of more than 150,000 practitioner-authored, human-edited technology stories from 35,000+ contributing engineers, covering AI, software engineering, Web3, cybersecurity, startups and science, and serves roughly 3-4 million monthly readers. The company builds and open-sources the publishing software behind the site — the Chowa collaborative editor, the Pixel Icon Library, the HackerNoon pixel font and the Editing Protocol — and monetises through business blogging credits, targeted ads, newsletters and AI content licensing. HackerNoon publishes no public API: probed on 2026-08-22, it serves no OpenAPI, GraphQL, MCP or A2A surface. Its machine-readable surface is a content and AI-access one — an llms.txt, a per-crawler robots.txt policy, RSS feeds and sitemaps — with a "live content feed API" advertised in llms.txt as coming in Q3 2026 and not yet shipped.

providers.name: Ziff Davis Enterprise
providers.description: Ziff Davis (Nasdaq: ZD) is a vertically focused digital media and internet company whose portfolio includes leading brands across technology, entertainment, shopping, health, cybersecurity, and marketing technology. Its brands include PCMag, Mashable, IGN, Lifehacker, RetailMeNot, Spiceworks, Everyday Health, IPVanish, Ookla (Speedtest), FullContact, and iContact, among others. The company operates a portfolio of advertising, subscription, and performance-marketing businesses rather than a single first-party public API product. This API Evangelist profile was surfaced as an Insight Partners portfolio lead; a public web crawl of the corporate site found an active investor-relations, newsroom, brands, privacy, and terms surface but no developer portal, API reference, or published API specification at the corporate (ziffdavis.com) level. A second enrichment pass on 2026-08-13 ran full contract discovery against www.ziffdavis.com — OpenAPI, Swagger, GraphQL, MCP, llms.txt and every /.well-known/ path returned 404, and the WordPress REST root returned 401 — confirming the absence, while surfacing three real corporate programs: a Bugcrowd-hosted Responsible Vulnerability Disclosure Program, a published data-protection compliance program (Data Privacy Framework self-certification for 32 named group entities, GDPR DPAs, CCPA request metrics, EU DSA statement, NIST SP 800-88 vendor security exhibit), and five first-party PHP packages in the ziffdavis Packagist namespace — none of which is an API client library. Ziff Davis brands with their own API surfaces are profiled as separate entries.

providers.name: Amkor Technology
providers.description: Amkor Technology is the world's largest US-based provider of outsourced semiconductor packaging and test services (OSAT), serving integrated device manufacturers, fabless semiconductor companies, and contract foundries. The company offers advanced packaging technologies including flip chip, wafer-level packaging, 2.5D/3D TSV, System-in-Package, and chiplet integration solutions for AI, automotive, communications, computing, consumer electronics, industrial, IoT, and networking markets.

providers.name: Roper Technologies
providers.description: Roper Technologies is a diversified technology holding company (NASDAQ: ROP) that acquires, manages, and develops niche market-leading software and technology-enabled businesses. Over three-quarters of revenue comes from software products across three segments: Application Software (legal, healthcare, government, education, and insurance vertical SaaS), Network Software (construction, transportation, and insurance network platforms), and Technology Enabled Products (medical devices, industrial, and RF identification). Key subsidiaries include Aderant (legal software), Clinisys (laboratory informatics), Deltek (project-based business ERP), Frontline Education (K-12 HR software), Vertafore (insurance technology), IntelliTrans (supply chain visibility), ConstructConnect (construction information), DAT Solutions (freight matching), and iPipeline (life insurance SaaS).

providers.name: Thomson Reuters
providers.description: Thomson Reuters provides over 137 APIs across legal, tax and accounting, risk and fraud, and trade and supply industries through their global developer portal. APIs cover Westlaw legal research, Checkpoint tax content, ONESOURCE tax software, HighQ document management, Legal Tracker matter management, and risk and fraud solutions including identity verification and adverse media screening.

providers.name: Bitmain
providers.description: Bitmain Technologies is a Beijing-based designer and manufacturer of ASIC cryptocurrency-mining hardware, best known for its Antminer line of Bitcoin (SHA-256) and other proof-of-work miners. Bitmain also operates Antpool, one of the world's largest Bitcoin mining pools, which exposes a public HTTP API that lets account operators programmatically read account balances, account and worker hashrate, worker lists, payment history, and pool-wide statistics. The Antpool API authenticates each request with an HMAC-SHA256 signature computed from the operator's user id, API key, and an incrementing nonce, and rate-limits clients to 600 requests per 10 minutes per IP. This company was surfaced as a portfolio company of Hongshan and enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline.

providers.name: CDW
providers.description: CDW is a leading multi-brand provider of information technology solutions to business, government, education, and healthcare customers. CDW offers eProcurement integration capabilities including a Catalog API, PunchOut (cXML/OCI), electronic purchase ordering, and electronic invoicing to enable procurement system integration with partners such as SAP Ariba, Coupa, Oracle, and Jaggaer.

providers.name: Bosch
providers.description: Bosch is a German multinational engineering and technology company producing automotive components, industrial technology, consumer goods, and energy and building technology. Bosch operates the Bosch IoT Suite, an open IoT platform offering device management, software rollouts, edge services, and IoT data analytics, along with open source contributions to Eclipse Foundation IoT projects.

providers.name: Cadence Design Systems
providers.description: Cadence Design Systems is a multinational electronic design automation (EDA) software and hardware company. Cadence provides tools for designing integrated circuits, systems on chips, printed circuit boards, and pharmaceutical drugs, with a portfolio that includes Virtuoso, Spectre, Genus, Innovus, JasperGold, Xcelium, Palladium, Allegro, OrCAD, and AI tools such as Cerebrus and ChipGPT.

providers.name: JD Technology
providers.description: JD Technology Group (京东科技集团) is the technology and cloud subsidiary of JD.com, delivering digital-transformation services to government, financial institutions, and enterprises. Its primary developer surface is JD Cloud (京东云), a full-stack public cloud offering compute, storage, databases, networking, AI, security, and industry solutions exposed through the JD Cloud OpenAPI. Developers integrate via signed (access-key / secret-key) OpenAPI calls to per-service endpoints, and JD Technology publishes first-party SDKs for Java, Go, Python, PHP, .NET, Node.js and iOS plus a cross-platform command line (jdc) on GitHub. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of hongshan and enriched from JD Technology's public developer surfaces.

providers.name: Tamr
providers.description: An enterprise data management company that uses machine learning to automate the mastering, enrichment, and classification of messy data across disparate sources. Helps large organizations unify customer, supplier, and product data to power analytics and AI initiatives.

providers.name: Fortinet
providers.description: Fortinet is a major US corporation and Fortune 1000 company. The Fortinet API provides programmatic access to its platform services, data, and integrations for enterprise customers and partners.

providers.name: Grover
providers.description: Grover is a Berlin-based consumer technology rental and subscription company that lets people rent smartphones, laptops, gaming consoles, cameras, smart home devices, and audio gear on flexible monthly plans ranging from one to twenty-four-plus months. With more than 500,000 active renters across the United States, Germany, Austria, Spain, and the Netherlands, Grover positions flexible tech access as a circular, subscription-based alternative to ownership, refurbishing and recirculating returned devices for resale. Grover is a consumer-facing service and does not currently publish a public developer portal or API; this profile captures its public identity and web properties for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: iQIYI
providers.description: iQIYI is one of China's largest online video streaming and entertainment platforms, delivering movies, TV dramas, variety shows, animation, documentaries, and original content across web, mobile (Android/iOS), and OTT/smart-TV devices. Beyond its consumer service, iQIYI runs a SaaS / OTT developer platform that lets partners launch their own branded streaming service with a RESTful API covering Video, Channel, Album, Search, and Player resources, plus AVOD/SVOD/TVOD monetization, analytics, audience management, and DRM. iQIYI also operates the QIYU XR developer platform for VR/AR device applications and maintains an active open-source GitHub organization. This profile entered the API Evangelist network as a portfolio lead of Hongshan and has been enriched from iQIYI's public developer surface.

providers.name: Linux Foundation
providers.description: The Linux Foundation is a nonprofit technology consortium that supports open source projects and ecosystems. It provides a neutral home for collaboration on open source software, hardware, standards, and data, and hosts hundreds of projects including the Linux kernel, Kubernetes, Node.js, PyTorch, OpenSSF, CNCF, RISC-V, and FINOS. The LFX platform offers tooling and insights for open source contributors and member organizations.

providers.name: Collibra
providers.description: Collibra is a data intelligence company providing a cloud-based platform for data governance, cataloging, quality, lineage, and AI governance. The Collibra Data Intelligence Platform helps enterprises discover, understand, govern, and trust their data assets through automated lineage tracking, policy management, data observability, and collaborative stewardship. The Collibra developer ecosystem includes REST APIs, GraphQL Knowledge Graph API, workflow automation, and a broad library of source connectors.

providers.name: Cubic Corporation
providers.description: Cubic Corporation is a major US corporation and Fortune 1000 company. The Cubic Corporation API provides programmatic access to its platform services, data, and integrations for enterprise customers and partners.

providers.name: Xpeng
providers.description: XPENG (Xiaopeng Motors) is a Chinese smart electric-vehicle company headquartered in Guangzhou that designs and manufactures smart EVs (G6, G7, G9, P7/P7+, X9, MONA M03) with in-house advanced driver-assistance and in-car software, listed on the NYSE (XPEV) and HKEX (9868). Surfaced as a portfolio company of hongshan and idg-capital. XPENG publishes no public developer API: its open platform (open.xiaopeng.com) is geo-restricted and account-gated, and no public API docs, specs, or SDKs were found.

providers.name: xTool
providers.description: xTool is a Shenzhen-based digital-fabrication brand, spun out of Makeblock and backed by HongShan, making CO2, fiber, and diode laser cutters and engravers, laser welders, and DTF printers for makers and small businesses, driven by its xTool Creative Space (XCS) desktop software. xTool sells through a Shopify storefront and runs a support and academy portal, a user community, and the Atomm maker-project platform, but publishes no public developer API, SDK, or API documentation.

providers.name: Robert Half International
providers.description: Robert Half International is the world's first and largest specialized staffing and talent solutions firm. Founded in 1948, it provides contract, temporary, and permanent placement solutions across finance and accounting, technology, marketing, legal, and administrative fields. The company is the parent of Protiviti, a global consulting firm. Robert Half does not publicly expose a developer API; integration is available through partner programs and ATS ecosystem connectors. Listed in the Fortune 500.

providers.name: Sykes Enterprises
providers.description: Sykes Enterprises is a major US corporation and Fortune 1000 company. The Sykes Enterprises API provides programmatic access to its platform services, data, and integrations for enterprise customers and partners.

providers.name: TTEC Holdings
providers.description: TTEC Holdings is a major US corporation and Fortune 1000 company. The TTEC Holdings API provides programmatic access to its platform services, data, and integrations for enterprise customers and partners.

providers.name: EPAM Systems
providers.description: EPAM Systems is a major US corporation and Fortune 1000 company. The EPAM Systems API provides programmatic access to its platform services, data, and integrations for enterprise customers and partners.

providers.name: Segway-Ninebot
providers.description: Segway-Ninebot is a global personal-transportation and robotics company, formed when Ninebot acquired Segway in 2015. It designs and manufactures electric kickscooters (the world's top-selling e-kickscooter brand, 13M+ units sold across 100+ countries), self-balancing personal transporters, e-bikes, and — through its Robotics division — RMP mobile-robot chassis and delivery/service robots (Nova Carter, NVIDIA Isaac-powered developer kits). Backed by HongShan. Its public developer surface is limited to Segway Robotics' open-source ROS / NVIDIA Isaac integration packages on GitHub; no first-party REST or OpenAPI product API is currently published.

providers.name: R1 RCM
providers.description: R1 RCM is a major US corporation and Fortune 1000 company. The R1 RCM API provides programmatic access to its platform services, data, and integrations for enterprise customers and partners.

providers.name: Agile Robots
providers.description: Agile Robots SE is a Munich-based robotics and artificial intelligence company founded in 2018 as a spin-off from the German Aerospace Center (DLR) Institute of Robotics and Mechatronics. The company develops force-sensitive industrial and service robots, robotic arms (Diana series), grippers and hands (Agile Hand), mobile robotics, and the AgileCore / AgileAI software platform that lets system integrators and operators build and deploy AI-driven automation for the automotive, consumer electronics, healthcare, and service industries. Headquartered in Munich's Sendling district with manufacturing across Europe, China, and India, Agile Robots reached unicorn valuation in a 2021 Series C and is backed by investors including Hongshan (Sequoia Capital China). This profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network; Agile Robots does not currently publish a public developer portal, REST API, or first-party SDKs.

providers.name: Conduent
providers.description: Conduent is a major US corporation and Fortune 1000 company. The Conduent API provides programmatic access to its platform services, data, and integrations for enterprise customers and partners.

bands.label: Minimal
bands.blurb: Index entry only; little beyond a description and a link.

providers.name: B612
providers.description: B612 is a consumer selfie and beauty camera application for iOS and Android, published globally by SNOW Corporation and operated in mainland China as B612咔叽 (B612 Kaji) by Yiruike Information Technology (Beijing) Co., Ltd. The app combines a real-time beauty camera, AR stickers and scene effects, user-created and creator-published filters, and photo and video editing tools, and has been distributed through the Apple App Store and Google Play since 2014. B612 is a mobile end-user product rather than an API provider: as of this enrichment pass the company publishes no developer portal, no public API documentation, no SDKs, and no machine-readable API artifacts on any of its web properties.

providers.name: Leapmotor
providers.description: Leapmotor (Zhejiang Leapmotor Technology Co., Ltd., HKEX: 9863) is a Chinese intelligent electric vehicle manufacturer founded in 2015 and headquartered in Hangzhou, China, which sold its first vehicles in 2019. Leapmotor designs and builds battery-electric and range-extended (REEV) passenger vehicles — including the T03 city car and the B03X, B05, B10 and C10 SUVs — on its own vertically integrated LEAP platform, developing its electric drive, battery, and intelligent cockpit and driving systems in house. Stellantis took a stake in the company in 2023 and, through the Leapmotor International joint venture, distributes Leapmotor vehicles across Europe and other export markets via leapmotor.net. Leapmotor operates connected-vehicle services — the Leapmotor mobile app, OTA software updates, and the Leapmotor Connected Experience — but publishes no public developer API program, developer portal, or API documentation; the vehicle cloud interfaces used by its mobile app are private and only reached through unofficial, reverse-engineered community clients.

providers.name: Aptiv
providers.description: Aptiv is a major US corporation and Fortune 1000 company. The Aptiv API provides programmatic access to its platform services, data, and integrations for enterprise customers and partners.

providers.name: Marlin Equity Partners
providers.description: Marlin Equity Partners (marlinequity.com) is a global investment firm founded in 2005 and headquartered in Hermosa Beach, California, with an additional office in London. The firm acquires and builds software and technology businesses, partnering with management teams to create strategic value through operational support, organic growth, and add-on acquisitions, with particular focus on financial technology and e-commerce segments. Its portfolio has included companies such as Bazaarvoice, Medius, StarCompliance, Exegy, and Learning Pool. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio-network lead and enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline; as a private equity investor rather than a technology service provider, Marlin publishes no public API, developer portal, or technical documentation.

providers.name: Collision (now Web Summit Vancouver)
providers.description: Collision was the major annual North American technology conference organized by Web Summit, held in Toronto from 2019 through 2024 and widely dubbed the "Olympics of Tech." Beginning in 2025, the event was relocated to the Vancouver Convention Centre and rebranded as Web Summit Vancouver, aligning with the global Web Summit family (Lisbon, Rio, Doha, Qatar). Web Summit Vancouver is contracted through at least 2027 and was held May 27-30, 2025; Web Summit Vancouver 2026 is scheduled for May 11-14, 2026. The Collision brand is retired but this profile is preserved for historical reference. Collision/Web Summit does not publish a public developer REST API; the conference operates speaker, partner, attendee, and press portals.

providers.name: Skyworks Solutions
providers.description: Skyworks Solutions, Inc. is an American semiconductor company headquartered in Irvine, California that designs, develops, and markets proprietary semiconductor products for wireless communications, automotive, broadband, connected home, industrial, defense, and consumer electronics applications. Skyworks is a leading provider of analog and mixed-signal semiconductors, with dominant market share in 5G RF front-end modules (35% market share). Products span amplifiers, filters, front-end modules, isolators, switches, and power management ICs serving mobile, automotive, IoT, and infrastructure markets. The company does not publish a public developer API but provides datasheets, evaluation tools, and design resources for hardware engineers.

providers.name: Guazi
providers.description: Guazi is a China-based used-car export, auction, and trading platform founded in 2015 and headquartered in Beijing. It connects international dealers and buyers with used vehicles sourced across China, offering sealed-bid online auctions, Buy It Now direct sales, a 200-plus-point vehicle inspection process, direct sourcing on request, and global logistics shipping to more than 50 countries via container and Ro-Ro. Backed by SoftBank Vision Fund, HongShan (Sequoia China), and Tencent, Guazi handles over 200,000 vehicles annually. This API Evangelist profile currently tracks the company's public web presence; no public developer program, API, or SDK has been found.

providers.name: Cheddar
providers.description: Cheddar is a business and technology news media company producing live and on-demand video, articles, and newsletters covering financial markets, technology, innovation, entrepreneurship, and culture for a modern digital audience. Founded as a millennial-focused financial news network and backed by Lightspeed Venture Partners, Ribbit Capital, Comcast Ventures, and Altice USA, Cheddar streams programming such as Opening Bell, Big Business This Week, and NYSE TV Live across its website, connected-TV apps, and social platforms. It operates as a digital media and content publisher rather than an API or developer-platform company; this profile tracks Cheddar within the API Evangelist network and carries no public developer API surface at this time.

providers.name: Belden
providers.description: Belden Inc. designs, manufactures, and markets networking, connectivity, and cable products and solutions for industrial automation, smart buildings, and broadcast markets. The company delivers end-to-end signal transmission solutions for mission-critical applications, including industrial Ethernet infrastructure, cybersecurity, and IIoT connectivity. Belden's Hirschmann brand is a leading provider of industrial network switches and management software with CLI, SNMP, and REST API interfaces for network device management.

providers.name: Corning
providers.description: Corning Incorporated is a Fortune 500 American technology company that specializes in glass science, ceramic science, and optical physics. Founded in 1851, Corning manufactures specialty glass, ceramics, and related materials and technologies for industrial and scientific applications. Corning's businesses include Optical Communications (fiber optic cable and hardware), Display Technologies (LCD and OLED glass substrates), Specialty Materials (Gorilla Glass for mobile devices), Environmental Technologies (ceramic substrates and filters for emissions control), and Life Sciences (laboratory glassware, cell culture, and bioprocess products). Corning does not publish a public developer API.

providers.name: MEQ Solutions
providers.description: MEQ Solutions is an Australian agrifood technology company delivering what it calls the world's only end-to-end measurement of red meat quality and yield. Its integrated hardware-and-software suite — MEQ Probe, MEQ Camera, MEQ Live, and MEQ Insights — gives producers, feedlots, processors, brands, retailers, and food-service operators objective, real-time carcass and eating-quality data. Deployed across Australia, New Zealand, the United States, and Brazil, MEQ has completed over 10 million scans across 60+ deployments and reports a demonstrated 10x ROI. The company is backed by Insight Partners. No public developer API surface is currently published; the meqinsights.com portal is a customer login.

providers.name: Blavity
providers.description: Blavity Inc. is a Black-owned digital media and technology company founded in 2014 by Morgan DeBaun, operating a portfolio of premium content brands and events for Black millennials and Gen Z around culture, technology, travel, and lifestyle. Its properties include Blavity.com (news and culture), AfroTech (the largest Black tech conference and media brand), Travel Noire (travel), Shadow and Act (film and entertainment), and 21Ninety (women's lifestyle). Blavity Inc. monetizes through advertising, branded content, events, and its Blavity Media Group agency. It is a privately held company backed by investors including 500 Global and GV, and does not currently publish a public developer API, developer portal, or machine-readable API specifications. This profile tracks Blavity as a company in the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Business Insider
providers.description: Business Insider is a global business and financial news media company founded in 2007 and headquartered in New York City, operating as part of Axel Springer. It publishes fast-paced coverage of markets, technology, finance, the economy, retail, media, and careers across its flagship Business Insider brand and verticals such as Markets Insider. The organization was surfaced in the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of the venture firm IVP. It operates consumer news properties and content syndication feeds rather than a public developer API program, so this profile tracks its public web presence and domain security posture rather than API artifacts.

providers.name: Emerson Electric
providers.description: Emerson Electric is a Fortune 500 global automation leader with more than 135 years of innovation history. Its portfolio spans automation systems, discrete automation, final control, measurement instrumentation, and test and measurement, marketed through brands such as Fisher, Rosemount, DeltaV, Micro Motion, ASCO, Bettis, PACSystems, Flexim, and NI. Emerson serves industries including power, oil and gas, chemical, life sciences, food and beverage, automotive, data centers, mining, and marine. This repository captures the public APIs, developer resources, and machine-readable artifacts associated with Emerson Electric.

providers.name: Maximus
providers.description: Maximus is a major US corporation and Fortune 1000 company. The Maximus API provides programmatic access to its platform services, data, and integrations for enterprise customers and partners.

providers.name: Woowa Brothers
providers.description: Woowa Brothers is the Seoul-based technology company behind Baedal Minjok (Baemin), South Korea's leading food delivery platform, alongside B-Mart quick commerce, Baemin Connect rider services, and robotics initiatives for serving and delivery robots. A subsidiary of Delivery Hero since 2021, the company runs a strong engineering culture through its Woowahan tech blog and first-party open-source libraries on GitHub (NestJS libraries, WoowahanJS, Redis tooling), but it does not publish a public developer API or developer portal.

providers.name: CohnReznick
providers.description: CohnReznick is a top-25 US accounting, tax, and advisory firm formed in 2012 by the merger of J.H. Cohn LLP and Reznick Group, P.C. The firm serves clients across more than 30 industries from offices throughout the United States and four offshore subsidiaries, with its global reach extended through membership in the Nexia International network (operating in more than 128 countries). In May 2024 CohnReznick became the first US accounting firm of its scale to receive a strategic growth investment from a private equity sponsor when funds advised by Apax Partners acquired a majority stake. As part of that transaction the firm operates under an alternative-practice structure: audit and attest services are delivered by CohnReznick LLP (a licensed CPA firm) while tax and advisory services are delivered through CohnReznick Advisory LLC. Largest practice areas include Real Estate, Renewable Energy, Government Contracting, Asset Management (private equity, hedge funds, private credit, REITs), Financial Services, Healthcare, Life Sciences, Consumer & Industrial, Technology & Media, Public Sector, and Private Clients (family offices, high net worth individuals, professional sports). CohnReznick does not publish a public software developer API; this repository documents the firm's organizational profile, practice taxonomy, and linked-data context for API catalog purposes.

providers.name: Pool
providers.description: Pool.com is a Web3 domain service provider offering Infinity Domains, enabling ICANN-accredited registrars and other partners to mint and distribute Second Level Domains and integrate Web3 naming into their services through Pool's registrar API.

providers.name: ThatGameCompany
providers.description: ThatGameCompany is an American independent video game studio founded in 2006 by Jenova Chen and Kellee Santiago, known for emotionally driven, art-forward titles including Flow, Flower, Journey, and the free-to-play social adventure Sky: Children of the Light. The studio focuses on creating timeless interactive entertainment that inspires human connection across all ages. It publishes no public developer API; this API Evangelist profile tracks the company as a technology / gaming entity and records domain-security posture from live probes.

providers.name: CMC Materials
providers.description: CMC Materials is a global supplier of consumable materials primarily to the semiconductor industry, including chemical mechanical planarization (CMP) slurries and polishing pads. Acquired by Entegris in 2022, CMC's materials portfolio is now part of the Entegris specialty chemicals and CMP solutions business, serving semiconductor manufacturers through advanced materials and process technologies.

providers.name: Dewu (POIZON)
providers.description: Dewu (POIZON) is a leading Chinese online marketplace for sneakers, streetwear, luxury goods, and collectibles, distinguished by its integrated product authentication (legit-check) service that verifies items before they ship to buyers. Operated by Shanghai-based Poizon and backed by Hongshan (formerly Sequoia China), it runs both the domestic Dewu (得物) app and the global POIZON marketplace. For developers it operates the POIZON / Dewu Open Platform (open.poizon.com and open.dewu.com), a partner program that lets sellers, ISVs, and ERP integrators connect to the marketplace over an app-key plus request-signature authenticated API covering product data, pricing, catalog search, delivery modes, and vendor information.

providers.name: MKS Instruments
providers.description: MKS Instruments is a global provider of foundational technology solutions for semiconductor manufacturing, electronics and packaging, and specialty industrial markets. Its product portfolio spans vacuum and gas delivery systems, photonics, lasers, optics, motion control, and process control. No public developer API or developer portal has been identified at the corporate level; technical integration is typically handled through product-level documentation, sales engineering, and partner channels.

providers.name: Meituan
providers.description: Meituan (美团) is a Chinese technology-retail company operating one of the world's largest on-demand local-services and food-delivery super-apps. Its platform spans restaurant food delivery, in-store dining and group buying (Dianping), grocery and instant retail, hotel and travel booking, bike and moped sharing, and payments. Meituan runs a partner/developer cooperation center exposing merchant, delivery/logistics, and local-services integration APIs to business partners; these are partner-gated and documented in Chinese, with no public OpenAPI specification, SDK registry, or self-serve developer signup surfaced at this time.

providers.name: RIVR
providers.description: RIVR (RIVR Technologies AG, formerly Swiss-Mile) is a Swiss robotics and AI company spun out of ETH Zurich that develops autonomous legged-wheeled robots for doorstep delivery across parcel, grocery, and instant food/convenience segments. RIVR pursues "General Physical AI" by combining large-scale reinforcement learning in simulation with real-world self-supervised learning from live delivery operations, owning the full stack from software to hardware for reliability, safety, and cost efficiency. The company operates commercial deployments with partners including Just Eat Takeaway.com, Swiss Post, Migros Online, Evri, and Veho, and is backed by investors including Hongshan and Bezos Expeditions. This profile is maintained as an API Evangelist network company record; RIVR publishes no public developer API surface at this time.

providers.name: Beike
providers.description: Beike (KE Holdings Inc.) is China's largest integrated online-and-offline platform for housing transactions and services, connecting home buyers, sellers, renters, and real estate agents. It operates the Beike (贝壳) platform and the Lianjia (链家) brokerage brand, along with businesses spanning existing-home and new-home transactions, home rentals, and home renovation and furnishing. Its Agent Cooperation Network (ACN) lets brokerages and agents share listings and commissions across a standardized workflow. KE Holdings is dual-listed on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE: BEKE) and the Hong Kong Stock Exchange (HKEX: 2423) and is headquartered in Beijing. This API Evangelist profile was created from venture-portfolio sourcing and enriched via the pipeline; Beike operates consumer-facing housing web and mobile properties and does not currently publish a public developer API program.

providers.name: Digg
providers.description: Digg is a technology news aggregation and community curation platform, relaunched under new ownership and backed by Andreessen Horowitz (a16z) and True Ventures. It surfaces trending stories, discussions, and video signals drawn largely from X/Twitter, ranking them by community engagement and editorial signals. The platform tracks contributor rankings, rising stories, today's highlights, and GitHub repository activity, positioning itself as an AI-assisted discovery hub for technology, startups, and AI news. As surfaced here, Digg is a consumer web product with no public developer API, SDKs, or documentation; this profile captures its identity and web/domain-security posture for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: CHINT
providers.description: CHINT (Chint Group) is a global smart-energy and intelligent-electrical solutions provider founded in 1984 and headquartered in Wenzhou, China, with operations across more than 140 countries. Its portfolio spans low-voltage electrical equipment (IEC and UL), power transmission and distribution systems, switchgear, instruments and meters, EV charging, and clean-energy systems including solar PV and battery storage, serving power utilities, buildings, telecom and data centers, industrial, and OEM sectors. CHINT does not currently publish a public developer API, OpenAPI definition, or developer portal; this profile captures the company identity and its public web properties. Added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of Hongshan (HongShan / former Sequoia China).

providers.name: PwC (PricewaterhouseCoopers)
providers.description: PricewaterhouseCoopers (PwC) is one of the Big Four professional services firms, with approximately 370,000 staff across a global network of member firms coordinated by PricewaterhouseCoopers International Limited (PwCIL). PwC organizes delivery across three primary service lines — Assurance (audit), Tax (tax compliance, planning, and reporting), and Advisory (consulting, deals, and risk). The firm operates proprietary technology platforms including PwC Halo (a suite of data analytics tools used to support audit engagements), the Trusted AI initiative (PwC's responsible-AI governance and assurance framework), and ProEdge (a workforce upskilling platform). In April 2024 PwC announced a multi-year alliance with OpenAI positioning the firm as both OpenAI's largest customer and its first reseller of ChatGPT Enterprise, supporting PwC's broader generative-AI consulting practice. PwC's research and insights surface — pwc.com/insights, the annual Global CEO Survey, the Global Workforce Hopes and Fears Survey, the Money Tree report, and regional industry outlooks — is the firm's primary public-facing knowledge product. PwC does not publish a public developer portal, OpenAPI specifications, partner API documentation, or a GitHub organization at the corporate level. The github.com/pwc handle is held by an unrelated individual user (Patrick Clearwater). Any technical integrations with PwC platforms are arranged through engagement contracts and the PwC Technology Consulting practice rather than through self-service developer credentials. PwC's content distribution is reader-facing (newsletter subscriptions, the PwC US Newsroom, LinkedIn, YouTube) with no documented public RSS feed endpoint exposing news, press releases, or insights as a syndication contract.

providers.name: Market Vibe
providers.description: MarketVibe (marketvibe.com) is a finance and technology news blog that publishes ongoing coverage under the tagline "The Financial Status of the World" — market trends, startup funding, and developer-focused technology news (for example, recurring roundups of Replit funding talks, feature releases, and AI developments). It is a WordPress.com / Newspack-hosted publication organized into Tech, Finance, and Lifestyle categories, offering articles and an RSS feed rather than a developer API product. It was surfaced as a 500 Global portfolio lead and added to the API Evangelist network; enrichment found a content/media site with no product API surface (only the default WordPress REST API at /wp-json/).

providers.name: Avnet
providers.description: Avnet is a global technology distributor and solutions provider that delivers electronic components, embedded solutions, and design and supply chain services to industrial and commercial customers.

providers.name: BYD
providers.description: BYD Company Ltd. is a Chinese multinational manufacturing conglomerate headquartered in Shenzhen, founded in 1995 by Wang Chuanfu and publicly listed in Hong Kong (1211) and Shenzhen (002594). Originally a rechargeable-battery maker, BYD has grown into one of the world's largest producers of new-energy vehicles (battery-electric and plug-in hybrid cars, buses, and trucks), power batteries (including the Blade Battery), consumer and automotive electronics, rail transit systems (SkyRail/SkyShuttle), forklifts, and solar and energy-storage products. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of hongshan and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment; BYD is a hardware and manufacturing company and does not publish a public developer or API program.

providers.name: Marvell Technology
providers.description: Marvell Technology, Inc. is a Fortune 500 fabless semiconductor company headquartered in Santa Clara, California. The company designs and develops data infrastructure semiconductor solutions including custom ASICs, data processing units, Ethernet controllers, optical and copper PHYs, switches, and storage controllers used in data centers, enterprise networking, carrier infrastructure, automotive, and consumer markets. This repository captures any APIs, developer tools, and machine-readable API artifacts associated with Marvell. Public developer documentation is gated behind a customer support portal and is not openly accessible.

providers.name: MUSINSA
providers.description: MUSINSA is South Korea's leading online fashion platform, founded in 2001 by Cho Man-ho as a streetwear community and now operating a marketplace that connects more than 10,000 brands with over 16 million members. The company reported roughly USD 3.3 billion in GMV and USD 907 million in revenue for 2024, returned to operating profit, and is pursuing a KOSPI IPO. MUSINSA runs domestic and global storefronts (musinsa.com, global.musinsa.com), a partner/seller program for K-fashion brands, and an engineering organization that publishes on the MUSINSA tech blog. It has raised funding from investors including KKR, Sequoia/Peak XV (formerly Sequoia Capital China / HongShan) and IMM Investment. No genuine public product/developer API or OpenAPI-backed developer portal was found during enrichment; a corporate CMS Swagger UI at dev-api.corp.musinsa.com is an internal tool (its public spec still points at the Swagger petstore demo), so this profile captures company identity and domain-security posture only.

providers.name: Meta Platforms
providers.description: Meta Platforms is a multinational technology conglomerate that builds technologies that help people connect, find communities, and grow businesses, including Facebook, Instagram, WhatsApp, Messenger, and Reality Labs.

providers.name: PKO Inc.
providers.description: PKO is a collective and investment group operating at the intersection of technology and entertainment. Describing itself as a community of founders, creators, execs, artists, angels and investors with more than 700 members, PKO runs online and offline networking events, mixers and collaborations, and invests in startups across metaverse, virtual worlds, VR/AR, web3 (crypto, NFTs, DAOs), the creator economy, gaming and esports, social media, platforms, marketplaces, communities, streaming video, and content and media. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and added to the API Evangelist network. PKO publishes no public API, SDK, or developer surface; founders submit pitches by email.

providers.name: Iron Mountain
providers.description: Iron Mountain is a global leader in storage and information management services, providing records management, data centers, secure shredding, digital transformation, and asset lifecycle management for organizations worldwide. Iron Mountain helps customers protect and unlock value from their physical and digital information assets.

providers.name: Booz Allen Hamilton
providers.description: Booz Allen Hamilton is a leading management and technology consulting firm providing services primarily to U.S. government agencies in defense, intelligence, and civil markets. The firm employs over 2,500 AI specialists and 8,000 cybersecurity professionals, and maintains a significant open source presence on GitHub with projects including the Solutions Delivery Platform, Open Data Platform, and Cognition data fusion platform.

providers.name: SK Ventures
providers.description: SK Ventures is a seed-stage venture capital firm run by general partners Paul Kedrosky and Eric Norlin that backs science-driven founders who are deep domain experts in their startup's field. The firm invests around themes surfaced through the founders' technology conferences (Defrag, Glue) — identity, software infrastructure, security, and emerging technologies — providing early capital, practical guidance, connections, and pathways to later funding rounds. Its portfolio spans 50+ companies including Blockstream, Wealthfront, Rachio, Sphero, Premise, FullContact, and Klue, with notable exits including FanDuel, Remitly, Cloudability, and Kinvey. Surfaced as a portfolio company of foundry-group and profiled in the API Evangelist network; SK Ventures publishes a marketing website but no public API surface.

providers.name: Alwans
